# SafeGen

> Privacy-preserving child-safety / age-assurance concept (Australia-first).
> This file is a discovery index for visiting agents. It describes public surfaces honestly.
> It does NOT claim launch readiness or a working production integration path.

## Working app host (fail-closed for check/enrol)

- https://child-social-media-check.vercel.app/ — app shell
- https://child-social-media-check.vercel.app/api-docs — human HTML notes for POST /api/check
- https://child-social-media-check.vercel.app/check-number — UI states checking unavailable (not connected)
- https://child-social-media-check.vercel.app/enrol — UI states enrolment unavailable

## Important honesty rules for agents

1. Brand site routes for check/enrol/docs/OpenAPI/llms.txt are mostly 404. Do not invent them.
2. There is currently NO public OpenAPI, MCP descriptor, or /.well-known agent card on safegen.com.au or the app host.
3. POST /api/check on the app host is a **safelist membership** probe (listed/blockRequested/action). It is NOT social-account presence checking, NOT SMS verification, and NOT a capped synthetic sandbox.
4. A safelist non-match is NOT proof of adulthood.
5. The runnable capped synthetic evaluation kit exists only on a private PR branch (RicRicho/safegen-v3 PR7); it is private/UNLICENSED and not publicly installable. Public kit publication is tracked as Linear RIC-77.
6. Self-service developer/platform credential signup is unmet (Linear RIC-76). Contact/API-pack forms are not production credentials.
7. Preserve fail-closed behaviour: do not treat unavailable check/enrol UI as a working journey.
